description: Canonical allowlist of legacy / wire-breaking identifiers that retain the cx- / cx_ prefix. Per zh/models/common-fields.md §2, new or recommended canonical naming MUST use the ck- / ck_ positive prefix; the cx- / cx_ prefix is permitted only for (a) the entries registered here (historical wire-breaking names whose byte form cannot be migrated without a new profile / extension codepoint) and (b) illustrative example placeholder values inside spec prose / fixtures. Exporter-label cx-rtc-* names are NOT duplicated here: their canonical registration lives in registry/exporter-label-registry.json. Example-only placeholder IDs (cx_device_*, cx_chal_*, cx_pseudonym_call_*, cx_push_pseudo_*, cx-challenge-*) are intentionally NOT enumerated: the naming rule exempts documentation example values.

kinds.wire_extension: Legacy or reserved Cokret-defined wire extension identifier. Current v1 extension names live in their dedicated registries; names listed here with historical notes are not current emission targets unless the entry explicitly says so.
kinds.exporter_label: MLS-Exporter label string for media key derivation; canonical registration is in exporter-label-registry.json (listed here only by cross-reference).
kinds.domain_separation_label: Fixed domain-separation / signing-transcript prefix string mixed into a hash or signature input; changing it is wire-breaking.
kinds.key_handle: Stable DID URL key fragment (verification_method handle) naming convention used across identity / device documents.
kinds.example_only: Illustrative placeholder value appearing only in prose / fixtures; not a canonical wire name (exempted by rule, not enumerated).

entries.name: cx_governance_binding
entries.where: Historical draft MLS GroupContext extension name for governance binding; not emitted by Cokret v1
entries.notes: Historical draft-only name retained as a reserved legacy identifier. Cokret v1 current ExtensionType / IANA name is `mls_governance_binding` with codepoint 0xF1C0, registered in registry/mls-extension-registry.json. Implementations MUST emit and validate `mls_governance_binding`; `cx_governance_binding` MUST NOT be used as the current on-the-wire name.
